notes.title: New Game Darkzan Arena
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41474569/945e3d030a4df84e090262f218b6d2e390ad4476.png

Hello my adventurers, are you ready for another adventure???
I come to inform you about my new game, Darkzan Arena, following the Adventure Rush line but going much further! Graphics! Mechanics! Enemies! Item! Everything you ever dreamed of!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41474569/288efd6313837d387507d50e111a10de486d9f25.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41474569/368c39851ff26db2e5752defd85e3863bafe0989.gif

Challenge the greatest legends and creatures in this epic coliseum! Collect your treasures and upgrade your gears until you become number one in the entire multiverse.
The game is an Arcade based on waves of enemies, each enemy has a unique behavior and a list of specific rewards.
A complex system of damage, experience, combat and resistance makes it necessary for the player to develop skills to get further and further, all of this mixed with a fluid and fun progress system that allows you to be the best with each accumulated victory!

Add Darkzan Arena to your Wishlist right now!

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41474569/42b7a6f3b2f371a5b6df0bf19fe0c386b9f51cd8.png
